title: Deciding and choosing
about: Collocations for decisions, judgements and choices: make or take a decision, have second thoughts, sound judgement, a tough choice, weigh up the options, pass up an opportunity.

parts.title: Tip
parts.note: У гороскопах англійською постійно йдеться про вибір і рішення. Почитай кілька й випиши нові сполучення. Нижче — сполучення цього юніту, згруповані за іменником: які дієслова з ним уживають і з якими словами він стоїть.

rows: make, take, come to, arrive at, reach, put off, defend
a big / unanimous / wise / sensible decision
consider, weigh up, take, have no … but to

items.pattern: make / take a decision (about sth / to do sth)
items.meaning: decide something after thinking about it; take is British and sounds a little more formal or official
items.example: We need to **make a decision** about the holiday by Friday, or the prices will go up.
more: The school has **taken the decision** to start lessons half an hour later.
I can't **make decisions** when I'm tired, so I'll sleep on it.
items.watchOut: «Прийняти рішення» — make a decision або take a decision: обидва варіанти правильні британською, take звучить офіційніше. Не accept a decision — це «погодитися з чужим рішенням». І не do a decision.

items.pattern: a big / major decision
items.meaning: an important decision that will change a lot in your life
items.example: Moving abroad with two small children is a **big decision**.
more: Buying a house was the **biggest decision** we'd ever made.
Take your time. It's a **big decision**, and you don't have to answer today.
items.watchOut: Серйозне, важливе рішення — a big decision. A great decision — це «чудове, вдале рішення», а не важливе. Large decision не кажуть.

items.pattern: put off a decision · put off making a decision · put off deciding
items.meaning: delay deciding until later
items.example: I've been **putting off making a decision** about the car for months.
more: Don't **put off the decision** too long, or the flat will be gone.
She always **puts off deciding** what to cook until everyone is starving.
items.watchOut: Після put off — дієслово з -ing: put off making, put off deciding, а не put off to make. «Відкладати» — put off або postpone, не put away (це «прибрати на місце»).

items.pattern: a slight hesitation · detect / notice a slight hesitation
items.meaning: a very short moment of not being sure before you speak or act
items.example: When I asked if she liked the present, there was a **slight hesitation** before she said yes.
more: I noticed a **slight hesitation** in his voice when he agreed to come.
After a **slight hesitation**, the boy jumped into the pool.
items.watchOut: «Легке вагання» — a slight hesitation, не a light hesitation. Slight (невеликий, ледь помітний) часто йде з hesitation, delay, problem, difference.

items.pattern: have second thoughts (about sth / about doing sth) · be having second thoughts
items.meaning: start to doubt a decision you have already made
items.uk: засумніватися, почати вагатися (щодо вже ухваленого рішення)
items.example: I agreed to run the half marathon, but now I'm **having second thoughts**.
more: Are you **having second thoughts** about the wedding?
He booked the trip, then **had second thoughts** and cancelled it.
items.watchOut: Завжди множина: second thoughts. Have second thoughts — засумніватися в уже ухваленому рішенні (після цього часто передумують); просто «передумати» — change your mind.

items.pattern: a unanimous decision / vote · be unanimous
items.meaning: a decision that everyone in the group agrees with
items.example: Choosing the restaurant for Gran's birthday was a **unanimous decision**: everyone wanted the Italian place.
more: The parents' vote was **unanimous**: the school trip will go ahead.
The judges reached a **unanimous decision**, and she won first prize.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /juˈnænɪməs/, наголос на другий склад, на початку звук «ю». Тому артикль a, а не an: a unanimous decision.

items.pattern: a degree of uncertainty / doubt · some degree of uncertainty
items.meaning: some uncertainty; things are not completely clear yet
items.example: The weather in the mountains changes fast, so there's always a **degree of uncertainty** when you plan a hike.
more: With any operation there's a **degree of uncertainty**, but the doctors are hopeful.
There was a **degree of uncertainty** about who was picking the kids up, so we both went.
items.watchOut: «Певна невизначеність» — a degree of uncertainty, не a stage і не a grade of uncertainty. Degree тут — «міра, ступінь».

items.pattern: a wise / sensible decision · it was wise / sensible to do sth
items.meaning: a decision that shows good judgement and is likely to turn out well
items.example: Leaving early was a **wise decision**: the roads were still empty.
more: Booking the hotel in advance turned out to be a **sensible decision**.
Staying at home with that cough was a very **sensible decision**.
items.watchOut: Sensible — розсудливий, розважливий. Не плутай із sensitive — чутливий (sensitive skin, a sensitive child). A sensitive decision тут не підходить.

items.pattern: sound judgement · have / show sound judgement
items.meaning: the ability to make good, sensible decisions
items.example: I trust my sister's **sound judgement** when it comes to money.
more: Choosing a good babysitter takes **sound judgement**.
Our old family doctor was known for her kindness and **sound judgement**.
items.watchOut: «Здорове судження» — sound judgement, не healthy judgement. Британське написання — judgement, американське — judgment.

items.pattern: defend your decision (to do sth)
items.meaning: explain why your decision was right when people criticise it
items.example: The head teacher had to **defend her decision** to cancel the school trip.
more: I don't need to **defend my decision** to anyone. It's my life.
He **defended his decision** to sell the car by showing us how much we'd save.
items.watchOut: «Відстоювати рішення» — defend a decision, не protect a decision. Protect — захищати від небезпеки: protect your skin from the sun.

items.pattern: reserve judgement (on sth) (until …)
items.meaning: not give an opinion until you know more
items.uk: утримуватися від оцінки, не поспішати з висновками
items.example: I'll **reserve judgement** on the new neighbours until I've actually met them.
more: The soup looks strange, but let's **reserve judgement** until we've tasted it.
My dad **reserved judgement** on my new haircut for a whole day.
items.watchOut: Без артикля: reserve judgement, а не reserve the judgement. Не keep judgement — кажуть reserve (рідше withhold) judgement.

items.pattern: arrive at a decision = come to a decision = reach a decision
items.meaning: finally decide, often after a long time thinking or discussing
items.example: After two hours in the shop, we finally **arrived at a decision** and bought the blue sofa.
more: The family **arrived at a decision**: Grandma would move in with us.
It took the tennis club months to **arrive at a decision** about the new courts.
items.watchOut: Arrive at, не arrive to (так само arrive at the station). Те саме значення — come to a decision і reach a decision (reach без прийменника).

items.pattern: make a choice (between A and B) · make your choice
items.meaning: choose one thing from two or more
items.example: There were so many cakes in the window that I couldn't **make a choice**.
more: You'll have to **make a choice** between the gym and the pool. We can't pay for both.
Read the menu carefully before you **make your choice**.
items.watchOut: «Зробити вибір» — make a choice, не do a choice. Do — для дій і роботи (do the shopping), make — для рішень, вибору, планів.

items.pattern: give sb the chance (to do sth / of doing sth) · be given the chance
items.meaning: let someone have an opportunity to do something
items.example: My grandparents **gave me the chance** to spend a summer on their farm.
more: Please **give me the chance** to explain before you get angry.
She **was given the chance** to study in Edinburgh for a year.
items.watchOut: «Дати можливість» — give sb the chance або the opportunity, не give the possibility. Possibility — це «імовірність»: There's a possibility of rain.

items.pattern: the opportunity / chance of a lifetime
items.meaning: a very special chance that you probably won't get again
items.uk: шанс, який буває раз у житті
items.example: A free week in Japan? That's **the opportunity of a lifetime**!
more: Singing on stage with her favourite band was **the opportunity of a lifetime**.
Don't say no. It's **the chance of a lifetime**.
items.watchOut: Of a lifetime, а не of a life чи of the life. «Раз у житті» англійською — of a lifetime або once-in-a-lifetime: a once-in-a-lifetime trip.

items.pattern: have a burning desire (to do sth)
items.meaning: a very strong wish to do something
items.example: Ever since she was a child, she's had a **burning desire** to see Iceland.
more: I've never had a **burning desire** to learn to drive.
After a week of hospital food, I had a **burning desire** for a proper pizza.
items.watchOut: «Палке бажання» — a burning desire, не a hot desire: hot desire має інтимний підтекст. Нейтрально — a strong desire.

items.pattern: would much prefer (to do sth) · much prefer A to B
items.meaning: like one thing a lot more than another
items.uk: значно більше подобатися; значно охочіше (щось робити)
items.example: I'd **much prefer** to stay in tonight. I'm exhausted.
more: My kids **much prefer** the beach to museums.
Thanks for the lift, but I'd **much prefer** to walk.
items.watchOut: Перед prefer — much або far, не very і не more: I much prefer tea to coffee. Після prefer — prefer A to B, а не prefer A than B.

items.pattern: consider (all) the options · consider your options
items.meaning: think carefully about all the possible choices
items.example: Before booking a holiday, **consider all the options**: a cottage might be cheaper than a hotel.
more: We **considered all the options** and decided to repair the old car.
Take a week to **consider your options** before you answer.
items.watchOut: «Варіанти» вибору — options, не variants. Variant — різновид чогось: a variant of a recipe, of a song.

items.pattern: take sb's advice · take / follow advice
items.meaning: do what someone advises you to do
items.example: I **took my doctor's advice** and started walking to work.
more: If you'd **taken my advice**, you'd have brought an umbrella.
She never **takes anyone's advice** about clothes.
items.watchOut: Advice — незлічуване: some advice, a piece of advice, не an advice і не advices. «Послухатися поради» — take / follow advice. Listen to advice теж можна, але тільки з to (listen to my advice); без to — помилка.

items.pattern: strongly advise sb to do sth / against doing sth
items.meaning: advise someone very firmly
items.example: The doctor **strongly advised** me to rest for a week.
more: I'd **strongly advise** you to book a table. It's always busy on Saturdays.
We **strongly advise** you not to swim here when the red flag is up.
items.watchOut: Advise /ədˈvaɪz/ — дієслово, зі звуком z; advice /ədˈvaɪs/ — іменник. «Наполегливо радити» — strongly advise, не hardly advise (hardly — «ледве»).

items.pattern: have a choice (of sth) · have the choice
items.meaning: be able to choose between different things
items.example: At least we **have a choice**: we can go by train or by coach.
more: Guests **have a choice** of fish or chicken.
If I **had a choice**, I'd never get up before eight.
items.watchOut: «Мати вибір» — have a choice; «не мати вибору» — have no choice. Не have a variant.

items.pattern: have no option (but to do sth) · have no other option
items.meaning: be forced to do something because there's no other possible choice
items.example: The last bus had gone, so we **had no option** but to get a taxi.
more: When the boiler broke in January, we **had no option** but to buy a new one.
I didn't want to cancel, but I **had no option**.
items.watchOut: Після but — to + дієслово: no option but to wait. Те саме значення — have no choice / have no alternative. Не have no variant і не have no exit (exit — вихід у прямому сенсі, двері).

items.pattern: a tough / difficult / hard choice
items.meaning: a choice that is hard to make because both options have good and bad sides
items.example: Chocolate or lemon cake? That's a **tough choice**!
more: Choosing between the two flats was a **tough choice**: one was bigger, the other was closer to the station.
Giving our puppy to my aunt was a **tough choice**, but she has a big garden.
items.watchOut: «Важкий вибір» — a tough / difficult / hard choice, не a heavy choice. Heavy — важкий за вагою: a heavy bag.

items.pattern: take the soft / easy option
items.meaning: choose the easiest way, which needs the least effort
items.uk: піти легшим шляхом, обрати найпростіший варіант
items.example: I was going to cook, but I **took the soft option** and ordered a pizza.
more: Staying in my home town would be **the soft option**, but I want something new.
Don't **take the soft option**. Walk up the stairs instead of using the lift.
items.watchOut: «Легкий шлях, легкий варіант» — the soft / easy option, не the light option. Take the soft option часто звучить як легкий докір: людина обрала найлегше.

items.pattern: pass up an / the opportunity / a chance (to do sth / of doing sth)
items.meaning: decide not to use a chance you have been offered
items.uk: відмовитися від можливості, свідомо упустити шанс
items.example: I can't believe you **passed up the opportunity** to meet your favourite writer!
more: She **passed up the chance** of a free holiday because she didn't want to leave her dog.
Never **pass up an opportunity** to sleep on a long journey.
items.watchOut: Pass up — свідомо відмовитися від шансу. Miss an opportunity — пропустити, бо не встиг або не помітив. Частка up обов'язкова: pass up the opportunity.

items.pattern: face a difficult / tough choice · be faced with a choice
items.meaning: have to make a hard choice
items.example: When the twins were born, we **faced a difficult choice**: move to a bigger flat or leave the city.
more: Many students **face difficult choices** when they finish school.
After the storm, the farmers **were faced with a difficult choice**: sell the land or start again.
items.watchOut: «Стояти перед вибором» — face a choice або be faced with a choice, не stand before a choice.

items.pattern: reject / dismiss sth out of hand
items.meaning: say no to something immediately, without thinking about it
items.uk: відкинути з порога, навіть не розглянувши
items.example: My dad **rejected** the idea of a dog **out of hand**, but Mum is still thinking about it.
more: She **rejected** my offer of help **out of hand**.
Let's not **reject** camping **out of hand**. It could be fun.
items.watchOut: Out of hand — без артикля, не out of the hand і не from hand. Обережно: get out of hand — «вийти з-під контролю» (The party got out of hand).

items.pattern: weigh up the options / the pros and cons
items.meaning: think carefully about the good and bad sides of each choice
items.example: We **weighed up the options** and decided a campsite was better for the kids than a hotel.
more: Take your time to **weigh up the pros and cons** before you sign anything.
She **weighed up the options** for an hour and still couldn't choose a dress.
items.watchOut: Weigh вимовляється /weɪ/, як way. Британською зазвичай з up: weigh up the options. Не measure the options.

items.pattern: come to a decision · come to a conclusion
items.meaning: decide something after thinking or discussing
items.example: We talked about it all evening but didn't **come to a decision**.
more: We still haven't **come to a decision** about the kitten.
The neighbours finally **came to a decision** about the fence.
items.watchOut: Come to a decision = arrive at a decision = reach a decision. Після come — to, після arrive — at, а reach — без прийменника.

warmup.uk: Мені треба прийняти рішення щодо роботи до понеділка.
warmup.q: I need to ___ a decision about the job by Monday.
warmup.explain: Прийняти рішення — make a decision (або take a decision). Accept a decision — погодитися з чужим рішенням.
Важкий вибір — a tough / difficult / hard choice. Heavy choice не кажуть: heavy — про вагу (a heavy bag) або велику кількість (heavy rain, heavy traffic).

warmup.uk: Розглянь усі варіанти, перш ніж вирішувати.
warmup.q: Consider all the ___ before you decide.
warmup.explain: Варіанти вибору — options. Variant — різновид чогось.

warmup.q: He's having ___ thoughts about the move.
warmup.explain: Have second thoughts — засумніватися в уже ухваленому рішенні.

warmup.uk: Ми не мали іншого виходу, крім як чекати.
warmup.q: We had no ___ but to wait.
warmup.explain: Have no option (або no choice) but to — не мати іншого виходу.

warmup.uk: Переїзд ближче до школи був розважливим рішенням.
warmup.q: Moving closer to the school was a ___ decision.
warmup.explain: Sensible — розсудливий. Sensitive — чутливий, sensory — сенсорний.
Arrive at a decision (або come to / reach a decision). Arrive to — помилка.

A.q: All eight judges agreed, so it was a ___ decision.
A.explain: Рішення, з яким згодні всі, — a unanimous decision.

A.q: I'll ___ judgement on the new café until I've tried the food.
A.explain: Reserve judgement — не поспішати з оцінкою, поки не знаєш більше.

A.q: You can trust Anna's ___ judgement. She's never wasted a penny.
A.explain: Тверезе, здорове судження — sound judgement, не healthy.

B.q: Before you decide, ___ up the options carefully.
B.explain: Weigh up the options — зважити варіанти.

B.q: The shop was closed, so I had no ___ but to borrow some milk from my neighbour.
B.explain: Have no option but to — не мати іншого виходу. Variant і possibility тут не вживають.

B.q: My brother has a ___ desire to climb Everest one day.
B.explain: Палке бажання — a burning desire. Hot desire має інтимний підтекст.

example.title: The job in Lisbon
example.uk:
Минулої весни мені запропонували роботу в Лісабоні. Це було серйозне рішення, і кілька тижнів я його відкладала. Мама наполегливо радила мені їхати. Вона казала, що це шанс, який буває раз у житті. Найкраща подруга сказала, що залишитися вдома — це найлегший шлях.

Щовечора я зважувала всі варіанти. У мене завжди було палке бажання пожити за кордоном, але молодша сестра сказала, що їй значно більше хотілося б, щоб я лишилася поруч.

Зрештою я дійшла рішення: поїду на один рік. Напередодні вильоту я засумнівалася, але не відмовилася від цього шансу. Тепер я впевнена, що це було мудре рішення.
example.en:
Last spring I was offered a job in Lisbon. It was a [[big decision|a2]], and for weeks I [[put off making it|a3]]. My mum [[strongly advised|b8]] me to go. She said it was [[the opportunity of a lifetime|b3]]. My best friend said that staying at home would be [[the soft option|b12]].

Every night I [[weighed up the options|b16]]. I had always had a [[burning desire|b4]] to live abroad, but my little sister said she'd [[much prefer|b5]] me to stay nearby.

In the end, I [[came to a decision|b17]]: I would go for one year. The night before the flight I [[had second thoughts|a5]], but I didn't [[pass up the chance|b13]]. Now I'm sure it was a [[wise decision|a8]].
